lines.plainText: Look thee 'tis so Thou singly honest man

lines.text: Here, take. The gods out of my misery
lines.plainText: Here take The gods out of my misery

lines.text: Have sent thee treasure. Go, live rich and happy,
lines.plainText: Have sent thee treasure Go live rich and happy

lines.text: But thus conditioned: thou shalt build from men;
lines.plainText: But thus conditioned thou shalt build from men

lines.text: Hate all, curse all, show charity to none,
lines.plainText: Hate all curse all show charity to none

lines.text: But let the famished flesh slide from the bone
lines.plainText: But let the famished flesh slide from the bone

lines.text: Ere thou relieve the beggar; give to dogs
lines.plainText: Ere thou relieve the beggar give to dogs

lines.text: What thou deniest to men; let prisons swallow 'em,
lines.plainText: What thou deniest to men let prisons swallow 'em

lines.text: Debts wither 'em to nothing; be men like blasted woods,
lines.plainText: Debts wither 'em to nothing be men like blasted woods

lines.text: And may diseases lick up their false bloods!
lines.plainText: And may diseases lick up their false bloods

lines.text: And so farewell and thrive.
lines.plainText: And so farewell and thrive

lines.text: O, let me stay
lines.plainText: O let me stay

lines.text: And comfort you, my master.
lines.plainText: And comfort you my master

lines.text: If thou hat'st curses,
lines.plainText: If thou hat'st curses

lines.text: Stay not. Fly whilst thou'rt blest and free.
lines.plainText: Stay not Fly whilst thou'rt blest and free

lines.text: Ne'er see thou man, and let me ne'er see thee.
